title: Proposed collaboration on Hunter syndrome (MPS II)

sentences.text: Exploring a research collaboration on Hunter syndrome (MPS II)
We are writing to Project Alive, which supports families with Hunter syndrome, and would also value the views of the National MPS Society and the MPS Society (UK).
MPS II is linked to lysosomal enzyme deficiency and the resulting storage of material in lysosomes.
A Mucopolysaccharidosis Type II Natural History study is completed, and a registry of lysosomal storage diseases is recruiting.
Studies of JR-141, tividenofusp alfa and intrathecal idursulfase are active but not recruiting.
Idursulfase and pabinafusp alfa are listed as enzyme replacement approaches, and the atlas holds less confidence on pabinafusp alfa.
We would like to explore a jointly designed study on MPS II, shaped with your community from the start: [study question], [design], [sites].
Any participation would follow informed consent and ethics approval, and we would share what we learn with your community.

sections.heading: What we would ask of you

sentences.text: Would you be open to a conversation about whether this idea is useful to the families you serve?
If so, we would value your view on how your community, registry or natural history work could take part, with proper consent and ethics approval.
We are not asking for any personal information about patients or families.
Could we arrange a short call at a time that suits you, perhaps [proposed dates]?
With thanks and warm regards, [researcher name], [institution].
